title: SIM Card Kiosk
scenario: A kiosk offers a tourist SIM but asks to photograph your passport and bank card together.

answers.A: Send the passport and card photo to secure the offer.
answers.B: Buy the SIM from an official carrier shop or airport counter.
answers.C: Ask what identity data the carrier legally needs before sharing anything.
answers.D: Take the photos but send them only after the kiosk calls its manager.

explanation: A travel SIM is useful, but a combined passport-and-card image is highly sensitive. Use a reputable carrier and share the minimum required data.
proTip: Convenience is not a reason to combine identity and payment documents.
